statements.text: A user who lacks a right to make tables or routines is stopped at the first statement that needs it. The error names the user, the schema and the right.
statements.notes: Not triggered live: it needs a user without %CREATE_TABLE/%CREATE_FUNCTION running setup. The lane's connection is _SYSTEM (%All); the versions lane's least-privilege user IVGAUDIT_RO is disabled and scoped to AUDITB (enabling it is the operator's). Evidence: the upstream unit tests on fakes (test_setup_stops_at_the_first_privilege_violation_and_names_it, test_a_violation_after_objects_were_created_says_so) passed in val-unit-3-c01. The error text match rests on premise P-0105 (IRIS's -99 wording).

IRISGraphEngine(schema_prefix='sqluser') -> ValueError (SQLUser is the default schema)

statements.text: Setup refuses a schema whose class package already holds classes the product did not make. Nothing is made.
statements.notes: Through setup the check is reached only on a namespace whose record names the requested schema or has none; AUDITE records Graph_KG, so initialize_schema(dry_run=True) on INFORMATION_SCHEMA meets the record check first (live case shown, IVGSchemaError mismatch). The upstream integration test on a real scratch namespace passed in val-scratch-1.

statements.text: With no record and the product's tables in another schema, or in several, setup refuses unless the caller named one. It lists each schema with its row counts and saves nothing.

statements.dependency: a namespace with no IVG Schema record whose IVG tables are in another schema or in several (the pinned fixture tests/e2e/test_262_record.py builds one in a scratch namespace; its tests were SKIPPED in val-e2e-1-c03, gate off, and are not in the gated subsets). AUDITE records Graph_KG; per the lane brief no scratch namespace is created here: open

statements.notes: Live: an engine on RXOTHER (AUDITE records Graph_KG): initialize_schema() and its preview raise IVGSchemaError naming both schemas; deploy_packaged_classes(conn, schema='RXOTHER') and GraphSchema.deploy_objectscript_classes(schema='RXOTHER') raise the same before any load; 0 journal records each; the record still reads Graph_KG after the run.

initialize_schema(dry_run=True) with schema_prefix=RXOTHER -> IVGSchemaError naming both
deploy_packaged_classes(conn, schema='RXOTHER') -> IVGSchemaError before loading
GraphSchema.deploy_objectscript_classes(schema='RXOTHER') -> IVGSchemaError before the rescue probe or any load

statements.text: When the record names another schema, every public call of the engine is refused. The error names both schemas, and nothing is written.
statements.notes: Mechanical and live: every public function of the engine class not in EXEMPT_METHODS (233, the guard's own selection criterion) and every public method of engine.graph/cypher/temporal/algorithms plus ledger meta/head/stats/history/enable/disable/redaction_in_progress/verify, each called with no arguments on an engine for RXOTHER: every one raised IVGSchemaError naming Graph_KG and RXOTHER; construction itself wrote nothing; 0 journal records. Not called: the 4 public class-level callables the guard does not wrap (TableNotMappedError, the classmethods from_connect and from_wrapper, which build a new engine, and the staticmethod snapshot_info).
live_cases: construct IRISGraphEngine(schema_prefix='RXOTHER') on a namespace recording Graph_KG: no exception, nothing written
every public engine method (233) on schema_prefix=RXOTHER -> IVGSchemaError naming both schemas
every public sub-engine and ledger method on schema_prefix=RXOTHER (no arguments) -> IVGSchemaError naming both schemas

statements.text: The core vector search procedure may fail to be made. Unless its width is the cause, setup stops with an error.
statements.notes: Not triggerable here: it needs the core kg_KNN_VEC procedure DDL to fail with an SQLCODE other than -260 (an error the deployed namespace does not produce, and changing the deployed objects is out of scope); no upstream test exercises it (searched tests/ for the RuntimeError text). Inspected: a non -260 failure of a core routine is appended to procedure_errors (:783-784) and raised as RuntimeError after routines.save() (:797-803), so the record of the others is saved first, as the statement's note says.
